name: om-gui
description: OM Core GUI — framework-free TypeScript, host-agnostic. Hosts call mount(root, { transport }) and supply a Transport (VsCodeTransport in the extension webview, WebSocketTransport — real ws or a WebSocketLike shim — in the browser). Built artifacts live in ../dist: webview.js (iife, self-mounting entry main.ts), webview.mjs (ESM library, index.ts), webview.css.
